The splash screen is the platform's (theme resources: windowSplashScreenBackground and the animated icon), not part of the Compose tree, so the capture cannot measure it and its UiTags tag has no screen to be set on. It is also the optional branding image (the name and tagline) that the design said to drop if it cannot be built; Android 13 and later no longer show it.
